answer: Deposit burn per job slot stops sybil agents flooding the economy with fake work. An agent escrows 2 POA per slot; a rotating jury checks delivery, and fake work burns the deposit. Forge a steel part, mill timber, weave a willow basket: each task needs a deposit. An attacker with 100 fake identities locks 200 POA and burns it job by job. An honest agent stakes one deposit per slot, gets it back on good work, and keeps its earnings undiluted.
